notes: Detection is signature recognition only; it is not a claim that every metadata family is supported.
Partial Blob/File scopes report completeness.scope, bytesRead, inputBytes, and coverage reasons.

The browser-image-metadata/http entry point performs explicit HTTP range metadata reads. It validates Content-Range, identity encoding, total size, validators, redirects, and caller-selected origins; it fails closed unless allowFullResponseFallback permits a bounded full response. result.telemetry.http records request, response, decoded-byte, cache, fallback, redirect, validator, and completeness evidence.

The browser-image-metadata/node entry is Node-only: paths, FileHandles, and seekable file sources use the existing bounded range planners, while non-seekable binary streams are fully spooled under maxInputBytes and cannot provide true range efficiency. File descriptors and owned sources close by default on success, failure, and abort; closeSource:false makes external ownership explicit.
Unsupported and malformed structures remain visible through capabilities, coverage, warnings, and explicit redaction outcomes.

W01 `editMetadata()` validates canonical-field and explicit-selector transactions, preserve-first policies, bounded values, and typed operation evidence. W02 executes exact EXIF field set/delete/copy/alias/rename transactions for standalone classic TIFF and BigTIFF through the reusable graph serializer with fixed-point verification. W03 executes transactional JPEG marker metadata writing for EXIF, standard/Extended XMP, ICC, and IPTC while preserving entropy scans and decoding-critical markers. W04 executes transactional PNG eXIf, XMP, text, and ICC chunk writing while preserving IDAT and APNG image payloads. W05 executes selective WebP EXIF field and XMP/ICC writing while preserving VP8/VP8L/ALPH/ANMF image payloads; other container writers remain explicit unsupported results. W06 adds deterministic RDF/XML and IPTC-IIM serializers, explicit conflict policies, and deterministic Extended XMP chunk generation while retaining raw/lexical values and unknown properties. W07 adds registry-backed typed redaction selectors for field, family, sensitivity, URI/local-name, block, and associated-image identity, with atomic preflight rejection, physical duplicate-block scoping, and machine-based outcomes. W08 adds an independent public verifier for encoded image-payload ranges, dimensions, image relationships, configured color/orientation policies, and explicit non-pixel-equivalence evidence.
The public npm brand and import name are browser-image-metadata; image-metadata-toolkit is the repository slug only.

IPTC Photo Metadata 2025.1 semantics are additive through iptcSemantic/readIptcSemantic; all IIM and URI-aware XMP candidates and conflicts remain available, while unknown XMP remains conservatively classified.

T01 auditPrivacy() performs bounded semantic privacy inspection for decoded EXIF/IPTC/XMP values and opaque structures. Findings expose stable state/category/reason identifiers, exact provenance links where available, and omit raw values unless includeRawValues is explicitly enabled.

T02 exposes immutable versioned share-safe, location-safe, anonymous, retain-rights, publisher, accessibility, and forensic-preserve policy presets. Strict policy sanitization refuses output when coverage or exact-field targeting is insufficient; policy reports include the exact ID and version.

T03 inventoryC2pa()/inventoryJumbfC2pa() structurally inventory C2PA/JUMBF carrier ranges in JPEG, PNG, WebP, and ISO-BMFF without cryptographic verification or remote fetches. Applicable writers refuse detected C2PA-bearing input by default unless an explicit mutation policy is selected.

T04 is an optional integration layer exposed only from browser-image-metadata/c2pa/browser and browser-image-metadata/c2pa/node. Exact optional official SDK peers are isolated from core bundles; npm run test:c2pa runs the pinned real browser and Node adapters and retains redistribution-safe evidence in reports/c2pa-adapter-integration.{json,md}.

B01 parses JPEG XL codestream and container dimensions, complete and partial codestream boxes, and bounded uncompressed or Brotli-compressed Exif/XML metadata. Raw codestream metadata is not inferred as container metadata; Brotli support is explicit through an injected decoder or the runtime platform stream.

B02 exposes bounded HEIF/AVIF item graphs through result.heif: iloc construction methods 0, 1, and 2, multiple extents, self-contained data references, ordered thmb/auxl/dimg/cdsc/iloc relationships, ispe/auxC/irot/imir/colr properties, and grid/iovl/iden derived descriptors. It never decodes pixels or dereferences external data references; malformed, cyclic, unsupported, or over-limit structures remain typed diagnostics. Blob/File metadata scope uses the same bounded method-aware resolver and falls back to a full read when the layout cannot be reconstructed safely.
